summary: Design, automate, and audit ESG data systems aligned with GRI, SASB, and ISSB. Build controls and assurance-ready outputs. Enrol today.
lede: ESG Data Systems, Controls and Assurance Readiness training helps organizations turn fragmented sustainability information into controlled, traceable reporting. It develops practical capabilities for assigning ownership, mapping source data, applying consistent calculations, retaining evidence, reconciling reported values, and assessing control effectiveness. You will practice building data dictionaries, source-to-report flows, spreadsheet and dashboard controls, RACI matrices, evidence tests, and assurance-readiness plans. The course uses established ESG reporting and management-system reference points while providing an overview of automation and AI-assisted anomaly detection without requiring production software deployment or machine-learning development.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, produce, validate, audit, or govern ESG data systems and sustainability reporting evidence. It suits professionals at beginner to intermediate level in ESG data implementation, with enough exposure to organizational processes to trace metrics across functions.
prerequisites: Working exposure to sustainability reporting, operational data, finance controls, internal audit, or ESG programme coordination is recommended. You should bring familiarity with your organization’s reporting cycle and at least one environmental, social, or governance metric. No programming is required. Exercises use spreadsheet and dashboard concepts rather than software engineering. Advanced automation and AI-assisted anomaly detection receive conceptual and operational treatment, not production implementation training.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
